title: gpt image generation was blocked
summary: we moved the endpoints to west us 3 and now it works again. sometimes fixing infrastructure just means finding a data center that feels like cooperating today. your pixels are flowing again. 🖼️

highlights.title: GPT Images Liberated
highlights.text: We relocated `gpt-image-1-mini` and `gpt-image-1.5` to a new region to sidestep some overly enthusiastic content filters. Reliable, block-free generation is back on the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai).
